'''R2-S4M''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] that had learned enough respect to serve as a [[bartender]] for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. In [[4 ABY]], he served drinks with a drinks dispenser and tray aboard the ''[[Khetanna]]'', Jabba's [[sail barge]], while it was traveling to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].

At the pit, a group of [[prisoner]]s that Jabba had ordered [[Death|executed]] fought back against the Hutt's [[Jabba's criminal empire|forces]], including the [[Slavery|enslaved]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who killed Jabba during the fighting. She and her ally [[Luke Skywalker]] then destroyed the barge, and during these events R2-S4M perished alongside the crime lord.

==Biography==
R2-S4M<ref name="R2-S4M">{{DisneyToyCite|set=Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|pack=R2-S4M|altlink=https://shopdisney.disney.co.jp/goods/4550424339713.html}}</ref> was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="Manufacturer" /> that worked as a [[bartender]]<ref name="Astromech Droid Pack" /> for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] who operated out of [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Jabba ordered that a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[prisoner]]s at his palace be [[Death|executed]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]], where they would be fed to the [[sarlacc]] that dwelt there. In order to view the executions, the crime lord traveled to the pit with much of his court on board his [[sail barge]], ''[[Khetanna]]''. R2-S4M was among those on board the barge, and during the journey,<ref name="ROTJ" /> he<ref name="EE" /> served drinks to those on the viewing deck, with two of the passengers taking glasses from the bartender's serving tray while the droid was stood near Jabba's dais.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Jabbasbartender.jpg|thumb|right|300px|R2-S4M serving drinks]]
At the pit, the prisoners fought back against Jabba's men before they could be executed, and on board the barge, their [[Slavery|enslaved]] ally, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] managed to close the shutters of the viewing deck, throwing the room into darkness. Chaos ensued inside the barge, during which Organa killed Jabba and then made her way to the barge's top deck. There, her and her ally [[Luke Skywalker]] fired a [[Me/7 double laser cannon|deck cannon]] down into the barge, escaping as the vehicle exploded.<ref name="ROTJ" /> R2-S4M perished alongside his master on the barge during these events.<ref name="EE" />

==Description==
The [[R-series]] [[astromech droid]]<ref name="Manufacturer" /> R2-S4M had learned enough respect to serve as Jabba's bartender and was experienced in the role.<ref name="EE" /> He had [[Color|white]] and red plating with a black [[sensor]]<ref name="Astromech Droid Pack" /> and stood 0.96 [[meter]]s (3[[Foot|feet]], 2 inches) tall.<ref name="Height" /> While serving drinks, the droid was equipped with a drinks tray that hooked onto the top of his two larger [[Limb|legs]] and a drinks dispenser that protruded from the top of his dome.<ref name="Astromech Droid Pack" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Jabba's bartender was never given an official name in the books or movies, but his design may remind you of some Earth-based beverages. With his drink dispenser, seven glasses, and a tray harness, this ''never-before-fully-seen'' droid served aboard Jabba the Hutt's sail barge. Also, if you look to the shadows, you may find him in ''Return of the Jedi''.|Entertainment Earth website|<ref name="url=https://www.entertainmentearth.com/product/star-wars-the-black-series-astromech-droids-3-34inch-action-figures-entertainment-earth-exclusive/hsb8671">{{WebCite|url=https://www.entertainmentearth.com/product/star-wars-the-black-series-astromech-droids-3-34inch-action-figures-entertainment-earth-exclusive/hsb8671|text=Star Wars The Black Series Astromech Droids 3 3/4-Inch Action Figures - Entertainment Earth Exclusive|work=Entertainment Earth|archivedate=20210419042842}}</ref>}}

[[File:Jabbas_bartender_photo.jpg|200px|thumb|Continuity photo of the droid]]
This droid can be seen briefly in {{Film|VI}} on board the sail barge,<ref name="ROTJ" /> Continuity photos from the set, revealed years later on the internet, show more detailed images of the droid.<ref name="SWArchives">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsarchives.com/dt_gallery/1983-continuity-polaroids|text=Return of the Jedi continuity polaroids|work=Star Wars Archives fan site|archivedate=20190916222601}}</ref>

In [[2016]] Entertainment Earth released an exclusive set of astromech action figures as part of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: The Black Series|''The Black Series'']], which included "Jabba's bartender" but did not give the droid a proper name.<ref name="Astromech Droid Pack" /> The droid was then identified as R2-S4M on a [[2023]] action figure released as part of [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory]] line.<ref name="Japan">{{ShopDisney|url=goods/4550424339713.html|text=Star Wars R2-S4M Figure Droid Factory Movie "Star Wars Episode 6 / Return of the Jedi" 40th Anniversary}}</ref>
